notes.notes:

notes.title: Desktop Portal Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! I can't believe it's actually happening, but Desktop Portal is releasing into Early Access today! 

Things are still a bit in their early stages, and there's lots of things I want to improve and add during Early Access. Development is by no means stopping anytime soon!

If you have any issues, want to suggest features, or just want to know more about Desktop Portal, check the pinned post in the community discussions to join the Discord!

I've also made a quick-start guide to get new users going quickly!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EdOCPzI3LG4

Thanks guys, and enjoy Desktop Portal!

notes.title: Desktop Portal Patch
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Update time is here yet again!

New Features:
 Automatic detection if the Desktop Duplication API fails. Will switch to window capture mode.
 Settings menu (and tons of new options on it).
 Switchable overlay dragging types.
 Semi-hidden option in config file to override SteamVR Overlay rendering quality.


Bug Fixes:
 Fixed windows only interacting with the first laser that touched them.
 Numerous random bug fixes.


Known Issues:
 Again, performance still sucks.
 Laser will occasionally deactivate itself when opening the bar from the watch.
 The button to close the bar is missing, use the watch to close it again.
 No tutorial.
 Window capture might fail under load.


See you guys at release tomorrow! :)

notes.title: Desktop Portal Patch
notes.notes:
Heyo! This is a patch for the release candidate earlier today.

Fixes:
 Mouse smoothing no longer sucks.
 Window capture will automagically fix itself if you resize the window.
 Re-enabled the FPS Bubble on the watch.
 Fixed some scrolling issues.
 Cleaned up some UI.
 Fixed things relating to look showing.


Known Issues:
 Performance still isn't great.
 Interaction will not work with some applications that don't support touch input.
 Keyboard doesn't support uppercase.

notes.title: Desktop Portal Update
notes.notes:
Release is right around the corner for Desktop Portal! This is the first release candidate build.

New Features:
 Reworked window capture selection.
 Added more usable desktop capture.
 Added 3d audio and sound effects.
 Optimized window capture. (Still have a lot to do in this area).
 New UI for the bar.
 Library rework.
 New watch.
 Tons of other random stuff.
 Fixed numerous bugs.


Known Issues:
 No tutorial for new users.
 RAM usage is somewhat high with lots of windows.
